To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the tone of earnings conference calls is an incremental source of information to the market and that this incremental information has predictive ability for abnormal returns and trading activity.
conference call linguistic content is a significant predictor for stock returns and trading volume and that the question and answer portion has incremental explanatory power.
conference call linguistic sentiment is a significant predictor for stock returns and trading volume.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the incremental informativeness and market reaction to the tone of conference call transcripts.
the incremental informativeness and the predictive power of the textual tone of earnings conference calls and how this tone is reflected in the stock returns and trading volume.
the incremental informativeness contained in the tone of quarterly earnings conference call transcripts.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the tone of the conference calls is informative and that the tone of conference call questions and answers are particularly informative.
earnings conference calls contain information beyond what is contained in the quarterly earnings press releases and that this information is reflected in the tone (sentiment) of the calls.
the tone of the conference call is a significant predictor and has incremental explanatory power over earnings surprise for abnormal returns, trading volume, and post earnings announcement drift.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
earnings conference calls provide a significant amount of incremental information that is reflected in the market.
earnings conference calls provide a unique opportunity to observe the market’s response to a firm’s management’s tone.
conference calls are informative and investors are able to extract information from the linguistic tone contained in the conference calls.
The main takeaway from our work is that
investors are incorporating the linguistic content of conference calls into their investment decision making process.
conference call tone is a significant source of information for investors.
the tone of earnings conference calls is a significant predictor and incremental information source for future returns and trading volume.
